title: Overstuffed, uncomfortable chair cushion
text: Overstuffed, uncomfortable chair cushion. Cushions too small, too firm and thick to be comfortable.  Unique cherry blossom design pretty and unusual, but material not washable (cover not removable).  Not a compatible choice for standard, already cushioned kitchen chairs.  Return was easy and quick.

product_metadata.title: Pillow Perfect Flowering Branch Throw Pillow, 16.5-inch, Ivory
features: Includes one pillow; suitable for indoor use.
Edges of pillows are knife edge; Made in USA or Imported
Easy Care - lightly spot clean or hand wash fabric with mild detergent and cool water; then let air dry
Measures: 16.5-inch length X 16.5-inch width X 5-inch depth (measurements may vary up to 1-inch since item is handcrafted)
description: As cheery as a spring day, this floral-printed floor pillow beautifully embellishes any room and makes an elegant addition to a nature lover's space. Set on a beige background, the vibrant red cherry blossoms with touches of light pink are delicately balanced on each branch. This pillow easily complements many decors, especially modern or traditional themes.  For more than 30 years, Pillow Perfect has been designing and manufacturing decorative pillows and outdoor furniture cushions for the largest online and brick-and-mortar retailers in the United States. We have always been focused on providing the highest level of quality, service, and style, and our talented in-house creative team is constantly watching design and color trends, ensuring that we are always ahead of the curve. Founded by current CEO/Owner Paul and his brother David in 1989, Pillow Perfect products have always been proudly made in the USA, and our Woodstock, GA facility is truly where the magic happens. Each pillow is cut, sewn, labeled, filled, and finished by our team of dedicated employees so you can enjoy it on your sofa, chaise lounge, or in your personal backyard oasis.
